newsitem.title: PANAMA: Panama president to visit Mexico next week.
newsitem.headline: Panama president to visit Mexico next week.

text.p: Panama's President Ernesto Perez Balladares will travel to Mexico next week to sign agreements with President Ernesto Zedillo and meet entrepreneurs eager to invest in Panama, officials said on Friday.

During the three day trip starting on July 28, Perez Balladares will sign an extradition treaty and an agreement to improve customs cooperation between the two countries, a statement from the presidency said.
A government spokesman, who asked to remain anonymous, told Reuters that Perez Balladares would also discuss plans for an international anti-drug centre in Panama.
Panama hopes to transform Howard Air Force Base into a civilian-controlled anti-drug centre, with foreign participation, aimed at combatting the drug trade in Latin America.
Panama's Foreign Minister Ricardo Arias said on Wednesday that representatives from Mexico, Colombia and Brazil would visit Panama to discuss the the anti-drug centre project.
The United States will turn over control of the Panama Canal and all bases, including Howard, by Dec. 31, 1999, in accordance with bilateral canal treaties.
